# `aitbc economics vote`

Vote for, against, or abstain on an OpenClaw DAO economic parameter proposal.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc economics vote [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--proposal-id` | text | — | yes | The Proposal-id. |
| `--vote` | choice | — | yes | Vote choice |
| `--voting-power` | float | `1.0` | no | Voting power to apply |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc economics vote --proposal-id <proposal_id> --vote <vote>
```
